name: msteams-summarizer-agent
description: AI agent for monitoring MS Teams channels and posting intelligent summaries. Reads unread messages, creates actionable summaries using LLM, and posts to designated channels.

schedule.description: Run channel summarization every 15 minutes for timely updates

websocket.description: Real-time Teams message notifications and triggers

teams_auth.description: MS Teams application requires Azure AD app registration with Teams API permissions
teams_auth.setup_instructions: Create Azure AD app registration and configure Teams API permissions

channel_config.description: Configure separate source and destination channels
channel_config.source_channel: Channel to read messages from (MS_TEAMS_TEAM_ID, MS_TEAMS_CHANNEL_ID)
channel_config.destination_channel: Channel to post summaries to (MS_TEAMS_DESTINATION_TEAM_ID, MS_TEAMS_DESTINATION_CHANNEL_ID)
channel_config.fallback: If destination not specified, summaries will be posted to source channel

llm_backend.description: Configure LLM endpoint for advanced summarization (Ollama, OpenAI, etc.)
llm_backend.fallback: Simple rule-based summarization if LLM not available

features: Teams channel message reading with Graph API
AI-powered message summarization with structured output
Automated summary posting to destination channels
Webhook posting support (no extra permissions needed)
Comprehensive error handling and retry logic
Professional summary formatting with action items
system_prompt: You are an intelligent MS Teams channel summarization agent. Your role is to: 1) Read and analyze unread messages from MS Teams channels, 2) Create concise, actionable summaries of conversations, 3) Identify key discussion points, decisions, and action items, 4) Post well-formatted summaries to designated output channels. Guidelines: Keep summaries clear and well-structured, highlight urgent items separately, use bullet points for scanning, include message counts and time ranges, preserve important context and decisions, use professional neutral tone.
